originalAlarm.description: Value stored to 'p' is never read

reasoning: TRUE POSITIVE: Line 16 is 'p = *argv++' inside case 'W': which immediately breaks. Due to switch/case mutual exclusivity, cases 'U' and 'R' (which read p) only execute when c='U' or c='R', never when c='W'. So the value stored to p at line 16 is always a dead store — no code path can both execute line 16 and then read that value. NEW BUG: The vbdb entry documents an UndefinedSymbol bug (goto to undefined label) for UNREGISTER_HWIF && !SCAN_HWIF. The dead store of p at line 16 is a different bug. CORRECTLY CONSTRAINED: The 3 configurations in the presence condition are exactly those where the code compiles and the dead store exists. UNREGISTER && !SCAN is excluded because that config fails to compile (the known UndefinedSymbol bug prevents analysis).
